data.body: Group10 comment-only candidate is signed at `2a12fbc2badebca8c3d33e6bb4c06c66af5b1532` (Rebar Bot author/committer/DCO, same Change-Id and source tree as reviewed `523a3163835c2a83175e95551595592f4b62abc0`). Independent non-author review passed all 99 grouped comment blocks (35 chargeful + 64 lavish), with receipts held for the exact merged SHA. The first full `make verify` on the byte-identical tree ended 19,710 passed, 93 skipped, 2 failed: unchanged `test_ref_backend_acquire_release_roundtrip` hit its 5-second temp-repo Git update-ref bound, and unchanged `test_a_transient_probe_stall_is_re_sampled_rather_than_reported` observed 4 rather than 3 Git shim invocations. Both exact nodes passed together under `pytest -q -n 2` on the same source tree (2/2 in 77.21 seconds). This is nonreproduction, not a causal diagnosis. Existing bug `wanted-clotty-bovine` holds the probe observation; new bug `sensible-curt-acouchi` holds the ref-lock investigation. A final full suite awaits the coordinated slot before Gerrit push.
